mapper.select: select * from member where member_account = #{memberAccount} and member_password = #{memberPassword}
mapper.update: update member set member_password = #{member.memberPassword} ,member_name = #{member.memberName} ,member_age = #{member.memberAge},member_gender = #{member.memberGender} ,member_phone = #{member.memberPhone}, member_height = #{member.memberHeight},member_weight = #{member.memberWeight} where member_account = #{member.memberAccount}
